dedupe_keys.name: fcc telephone company financial and operating report data armis reports archived at the us national archives

description: The Federal Communications Commission collected detailed financial and operating reports from Tier 1 telephone companies, those under FCC jurisdiction with annual operating revenues above 100 million dollars, to analyse revenue requirements and rates of return, support audits and quantify the effects of policy proposals. The series preserved by the US National Archives contains FCC Report 43.02 (Uniform System of Accounts), Report 43.03 (Joint Cost), Report 43.04 (Access) and Report 495B (Actual Usage of Investment): operating results for every account, including salaries, rents and benefits; study area data for regulated and non-regulated operations; the results of jurisdictional separations and access charges; and investment and usage by cost category. These reports formed the FCC's Automated Reporting Management Information System (ARMIS), whose other reports covered service quality, outages and infrastructure. Coverage: large US local exchange carriers, from the late 1980s to the end of ARMIS reporting. Format and access: archival electronic records ordered from the National Archives (catalogue entry in the Archival Research Catalog); public records, available at reproduction cost. Caveats: accounting data by carrier and study area, not by asset location; reporting rules changed over time. Simulation uses: long series of investment, plant and costs of US telephone networks for economic and ageing models of legacy copper networks. Related records: the FCC Form 477 and consumer complaint records.
